name: Kevin Hern
summary:
Kevin Ray Hern (born December 4, 1961) is an American politician and businessman who is a United States senator-elect from Oklahoma. A member of the Republican Party, he has represented Oklahoma's 1st congressional district in the United States House of Representatives since 2018. 
Born in Missouri and raised in Pope County, Arkansas, Hern graduated from Arkansas Tech University in 1986 and briefly attended the Georgia Institute of Technology.
